learn.title: Learn
learn.subtitle: How to work with orders and get paid

take.title: How to take an order
take.text: Pick a task in “Orders”: check the rate per 1,000 views, the remaining budget and the view threshold. Read the description and video requirements, then tap “Apply”. You have 7 days to publish and submit the video — after that the slot expires.

shoot.title: How to shoot a video that fits the requirements
shoot.text: Check the orientation and duration in the order card, and the reference if there is one. A moderator will reject a video that doesn't meet the requirements.

submit.title: How to submit a video and get paid
submit.text: Publish the video on your social media. Once it reaches the view threshold, send the link and the current view count in “My videos” — payment for the threshold is reserved right away. A moderator checks the views and credits you for all of them; 5 days later they record the final count and top up for new views while the order has budget. Until then the money is on hold; after that you can withdraw it. Each video is paid once; the next one for the same order — after a decision on the previous one. Keep the post public: if it's gone at the final check, the payment is cancelled.

withdraw.title: How to withdraw money
withdraw.text: Earnings for videos add up on your balance in USDT: “Profile” → “Balance”. The money for a video shows up right after approval, and you can withdraw it 5 days later, once a moderator records the final views and checks the post is still there — this is the hold. It exists because sometimes a video gets approved and immediately deleted, while the advertiser paid for a placement that no longer exists. “Balance” shows how much is on hold and when the next amount is released. Add a USDT wallet on the TRC20 network in your profile and request a withdrawal of 10 USDT or more — a manager will send the money to that wallet.

rules.title: Platform rules
rules.text: Don't leave contacts in videos or comments — communication and payments go through Fixum support. Someone else's or re-uploaded videos are not accepted.

👋 Fixum is a marketplace for video ads.

Advertisers post tasks, creators take them on and get paid for views.

Orders, applications and moderation are in the app 👇
Questions? Just send a message here — a Fixum manager will reply.

insights.notTaken: {{viewers}} creators opened the order, but {{taken}} took it. The terms don't attract them: lower the view threshold, relax the duration and format requirements, attach an example video.
insights.slotsBurn: {{expired}} of {{taken}} creators took the order but didn't send a video in time. The task seems harder than it looks: simplify the requirements or describe it in more detail.
insights.rejected: The moderator rejected {{rejected}} of {{judged}} videos — creators misunderstand the task. Clarify the order description.
insights.lowEngagement: Likes are {{percent}}% of views: people watch the videos but don't react. Try a different message or format.
insights.lowClicks: The videos were watched {{views}} times, but only {{clicks}} people clicked the product link. Viewers don't go to the site: ask creators to directly invite people to the link in the description and show what the viewer gets.
insights.budgetEnding: The videos are getting views, but the budget is almost spent — {{left}} left. To keep videos coming, increase the order budget.
insights.deadline: Less than 2 days until the deadline, and less than half the budget is spent. Extend the deadline in “My campaigns” to collect more videos.
